# Flux Hands 1.0.9

- Android ARM64 test APK for Android 15 and newer, using a remote OpenHands Agent Server.
- Kilo Free and OpenAI-compatible remote model configuration on Android.
- Android APK is checked for a valid signature before it is attached to this release.
- Fixed OpenHands connection validation and repeat-task handling on desktop.
- Updated Android build runner setup; Windows desktop installers and daily updater are included.
